sentences.span: A day after SpaceX went looking for $40 billion in chip-collateralized SPV debt, sending its CDS into geostationary orbit
sentences.why: Every source (19795, 19327, 19753, 19323, 19439, 19418, 19751, 19730, and others) describes SpaceX as 'seeking', 'looking to raise', or 'wanting to raise' $40bn — talks in progress, not a completed raise. The WSJ quote even says SpaceX 'talked to lenders in recent days.' The pulse sentence asserts 'SpaceX raised $40BN' as a completed fact, turning an in-progress financing search into a done deal.

sentences.span: Broadcom has spent the past few weeks working to arrange more than $50 billion in financing for OpenAI's custom AI chip, with Apollo and Blackstone among the lenders it has approached
we recommend adding a receive position in 10s versus 5s and 30s on the 5s10s30s SOFR fly (entry: 2bp; target: -4bp; stop: 6bp)
sentences.why: Goldman Sachs (Global Rates Trader) note matches the trade, entry, target and stop exactly; 'fading the latest phase of 10y underperformance' supports the 'selloff has run far enough' framing.

sentences.span: GS Prime data shows Mag 7 exposure has climbed to around 22% of total US exposure, the highest level since their data begins in 2022
sentences.why: Matches figure (22%) and the 'highest since 2022' framing, corroborated across many other files (19424, 19421, 19839, etc.).

sentences.span: Simonet is telling clients that "positioning is no longer a cushion" and pitching $859 million of 6-month best-of puts across 29 AI and AI-adjacent names
sentences.why: Figures match exactly (Adrien Simonet, Goldman equity derivatives desk, referred to as 'his desk').

sentences.span: Goldman TMT specialist Sean Johnstone explains that it was all a misunderstanding. OpenAI reports revenue net of what its cloud partners sell, while Anthropic "reports closer to gross revenue"
sentences.why: Direct match of attribution and explanation.

sentences.span: the Nasdaq fell 1.25%, the SOX dropped 3.4%, and Oracle (ORCL) lost 5.5%, Broadcom (AVGO) 4.4%, Nvidia (NVDA) 2.9% and CoreWeave (CRWV) 7.8%
sentences.why: Exact match of all six figures.

sentences.span: Bloomberg then reported that the company expects to reach at least $70 billion by year-end, which was enough to lift NDX back to unchanged on the week
sentences.why: Direct, near-verbatim match including the causal claim about the Nasdaq 100 move.

sentences.span: Oracle's 5-year CDS hit a record 261bp and Broadcom's a record 136bp once the revenue question was raised about their largest customer
sentences.why: 'Default insurance' is a faithful plain-English rendering of CDS; both figures and the causal link to the OpenAI revenue question match.

sentences.span: Governor Waller's comments suggested that he likely expects two additional rate hikes to be appropriate, which would raise the funds rate to 4.25-4.50%
sentences.why: Near-verbatim match; note this is distinct from GS's own separate house forecast (one hike, to 4-4.25%) elsewhere in the same note, but the sentence correctly attributes the two-hike/4.25-4.50% figure to Waller's own view.

sentences.span: See Binky and Parag's preview of US Q3 earnings here where they see a stunning 34% YoY EPS growth
sentences.why: Deutsche Bank (DB CoTD) note states its own strategists' 34% YoY EPS growth forecast for Q3.

sentences.span: oil still closed up 4% on the day, and the real decline only arrived overnight, when Brent slid back toward $103
sentences.why: Exact match; the source's own section header calls Trump's pledge 'A Midterm (One-Sided) Ceasefire', supporting the 'ceasefire pledge' framing.

sentences.span: Hormuz flows running at roughly 9.5 million barrels a day, still about 30% below pre-war levels
sentences.why: Exact figures match; source separately states physical/dated-Brent tightness is driving price persistence, supporting the 'stickiness' framing.

sentences.span: Nomura's Charlie McElligott... writing that it is "100d" (that is, a 100-delta certainty in his view) that the attacks resume once the votes are counted
sentences.why: Matches McElligott's certainty and the claim that (Trump's) Iran attacks resume after the midterms; the pledge itself was that the US would not attack Iran before the midterms, so 'Trump resumes Iran attacks' is the correct referent.

sentences.span: For investors seeking to hedge upside risk to oil prices, we still recommend long summer2027 European gasoline positions
sentences.why: Direct, near-verbatim match including the hedge rationale.
